headline: IO Interactive lays off staff after losing Microsoft as Project Fantasy partner
summary: The game studio behind Hitman is cutting jobs after parting ways with a partner on its next big RPG. Project Fantasy's future remains uncertain.
details: IO Interactive announced it is laying off staff after ending a relationship with an external partner on its next big franchise, Project Fantasy. The company described Project Fantasy as an 'online fantasy RPG'.

The partnership was reportedly with Microsoft, which is planning significant cuts as part of a broader 'reset' of the Xbox business. It's unclear how many people will be affected by IO's 'staffing decisions'.

IO Interactive remains '100% committed to' Project Fantasy and promises that 'this wonderful universe will see the light of day.' The layoffs follow the success of 007 First Light, which was released in May and quickly sold 3 million copies.

An Xbox spokesperson said the company is 'taking a fresh look at where we invest so we're focusing on our highest priorities.' The spokesperson added that Xbox is 'not reducing our overall investment in games' and that 'We expect to invest about the same in content as we did last year. What's changing is where we're investing and the kinds of projects we're backing.'

headline: Xbox layoffs hit Arkane Studios with closures, game cancellations
summary: Microsoft plans to lay off staff at Xbox, possibly closing Arkane Studios and canceling Marvel's Blade.
details: Microsoft is planning layoffs at Xbox that could start on July 6, with Arkane Studios and the game Marvel's Blade reportedly affected. The layoffs are part of a broader restructuring effort.
Arkane Studios, known for the Dishonored series and Deathloop, might be closed or sold off. The studio's future is uncertain as Microsoft explores options.
The Xbox division has been undergoing significant changes, including previous layoffs and studio closures. The company acquired Activision Blizzard King in 2023 and ZeniMax in 2021.
The video game market has seen significant job losses, with an estimated 14,600 employees laid off in 2024 and 10,500 in 2023.
caption:
Xbox layoffs hit Arkane Studios with possible closure and game cancellations

Microsoft is planning layoffs at Xbox that could start on July 6, with Arkane Studios and the game Marvel's Blade reportedly affected. The layoffs are part of a broader restructuring effort.

Arkane Studios, known for the Dishonored series and Deathloop, might be closed or sold off. The studio's future is uncertain as Microsoft explores options.

The Xbox division has been undergoing significant changes, including previous layoffs and studio closures. The company acquired Activision Blizzard King in 2023 and ZeniMax in 2021.

The video game market has seen significant job losses, with an estimated 14,600 employees laid off in 2024 and 10,500 in 2023.
